title: del~

messages.description: signal input into the delay line (as [del~ in])
dummy outlet to force order of execution (as [del~ in])

flags.name: -samps
flags.description: sets time value to samples (default is ms)

body: [del~] sets and writes to a delay line if created as [del~ in] (default) and reads from it (with interpolation) if created as [del~ out]. It's quite similar to [delread~]/[delread4~], but with more features.
